title: Fix AITDK 429 rate limit handling, add backoff retry, eliminate toxic single-domain fallback on 429, and optimize batch size and pacing
summary: 1) In fetchBatch, retry on HTTP 429 directly with backoff (up to 2 retries, 3.5s/7s or Retry-After header) instead of dropping the connection; 2) Ensure directError is always assigned with HTTP 429 details so error messages are informative and never swallowed into generic 'Không gọi được AITDK'; 3) In search(), detect 429 Rate Limit and pause 8s without triggering single-domain fallback storms (preventing rate limit amplification); 4) Restore BATCH_SIZE to 10 domains (reducing request count by 50% for 50-domain jobs); 5) Add INTER_BATCH_DELAY_MS of 2500ms to stay comfortably under AITDK rate limits.
